deskyard computer stop: stop a computer

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer stop NAME

Saves that the computer should be stopped and stops it, keeping its container
and files; the server answers at once. Needs full access to it.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  computer name

Options:
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard computer stop alice

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
